children: The Reserve Bank of Australia has more work to do to tame inflation, and by the time it is done, the official cash rate should be at its highest level since 2008, says Adam Boyton, head of Australian economics at ANZ. The RBA will likely raise its policy rate next week and again in November, taking the official cash rate to 4.85%, he adds. The ongoing escalation of the conflict in the Middle East and the tendency of the RBA to view the rise in oil prices as much more of an inflation shock than a growth shock suggest the RBA is prepared to act, he says. (james.glynn@wsj.com; @JamesGlynnWSJ)
